name: AI-assisted seismic interpretation and history matching
aliases: AI-assisted seismic interpretation and history matching
principle: Machine-learning models, mostly convolutional neural networks, pick faults, horizons and geobodies, classify lithofacies and speed up denoising and velocity work, while automated and assisted history matching tunes reservoir models. A review of more than 500 SEG and EAGE papers (2010 to 2021) finds ML improves individual tasks but has not yet replaced whole workflows.

process_steps.name: Train on labelled seismic or simulation data

advantages: Fault detection is highly effective by the review's scoring
limitations: Models trained on synthetic data can underperform on field data
Many studies lack quantitative accuracy metrics

sources.note: Geophysics 89(1) WA157, Machine learning for seismic exploration: where are we and how far are we from the holy grail? (review of more than 500 SEG and EAGE publications, 2010 to 2021)
